summary_md: **Fisher D. ([@ChanglerD](https://x.com/ChanglerD/status/2115114254621880499))** open-sources **scientific-workflow-skills**: six Agent Skills used during PhD thesis writing so Codex, Claude Code and Cursor can handle repetitive lab-software work in medicinal chemistry (MestReNova NMR processing, Prism IC50 analysis, ChemDraw OLE, Illustrator figures, characterization curation, figure formatting). The self-reply thread lists the skills and design rules: originals are never modified, work happens on copies, and the agent reports what it did and didn't check.

media.ocr_text: Software → Skill → Output. MestReNova: nmr-processing → .mnova + .png spectra. GraphPad Prism: prism-ic50-analysis → IC50 summary table. ChemDraw + Word/PPT: chemdraw-ole → editable Word/PPT. Adobe Illustrator: illustrator-scientific-figure → editable .ai figure. General skills, not tied to specific software: NMR / IR / HRMS / HPLC records: characterization-curation → SI characterization table. Any figure software: scientific-figure-format → format review notes.
